definitions: To have a shared understanding or agreement about something.
To be in agreement about a situation or plan.
examples: Before we start the project, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
It's important for the team to be on the same page regarding the new policy.
We need to get on the same page about the budget.
lemma: to be on the same page
synonyms: to be on the same wavelength
source: to be on the same page
